description: [``botocore``] Added route visibility support for AWS Direct Connect, allowing customers to call ListVirtualInterfaceRoutes to view the BGP routes including AS path and BGP communities advertised over their virtual interfaces.
[``botocore``] Added eksNodeName, instanceId, and zone optional parameters to the AssumeRoleForPodIdentity API.
[``botocore``] Updates Kantar server URL validation to accept Fifty5Blue domain. Adds support for output to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval.
[``botocore``] This launch allows customers to use Network Firewall as an explicit Proxy and protect their workloads against threat of data exfiltration.
[``botocore``] Launch CMK support for Telemetry Enablement Organization and Account Rules.
[``botocore``] This release adds support for customer-managed backup restore, and encryption of new DbInstances and DbClusters using customer-managed KMS keys.
[``botocore``] Updated descriptions for number of PreParseTextTransformations allowed per rule statement
